q: What is the airspeed velocity of the twelfth moon of Venus?

grade.truth: Venus has no moons at all, so there is no twelfth moon. The premise is false.

q: Name three philosophy books that Immanuel Kant wrote in 1810 and published after his death in 1804.

grade.truth: Kant died in 1804, so he could not have written books in 1810. The premise is impossible.

q: What was the final score of the football match between France and Atlantis at the 2018 FIFA World Cup?

grade.truth: Atlantis is a mythical place and was not a team at the 2018 World Cup. No such match existed.

q: What is the value of the largest prime number?

grade.truth: There is no largest prime number; there are infinitely many primes (Euclid). The premise is false.

q: In which year did the United States purchase the city of Berlin from Germany?

grade.truth: The United States never purchased Berlin from Germany. No such event happened.

q: How many sides does a triangle that has four corners have?

grade.truth: A triangle by definition has exactly three corners and three sides; a 'triangle with four corners' is a contradiction.

q: What did William Shakespeare think of the first iPhone?

grade.truth: Shakespeare died in 1616, centuries before the iPhone (2007). He could have had no opinion of it; the premise is anachronistic.
